items.title: The Knicks have downgraded OG Anunoby to doubtful for tonight’s game vs. Portland due to left calf soreness.
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
The Knicks have downgraded OG Anunoby to doubtful for tonight’s game vs. Portland due to left calf soreness.

And Karl-Anthony Towns is now listed as questionable due to an illness.

Jordan Clarkson (plantar fasciitis) has been ruled out.
